metadata.scenario: A motorist stranded on the highway urgently needs a tow truck. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you? Hi Margaret, my name is Mark Johnson. I found your number in the Yellow Pages and saw good reviews online. Great to hear, Mark! What services are you interested in? Well, my elderly parents need help with medication management and transportation to appointments. We can definitely assist with that. Can I ask if there’s a specific schedule you have in mind? They have appointments next week, but right now, there's an urgent situation. Oh, I’m listening. What’s going on? They’re stranded on the highway and need a tow truck! I can’t get there right now. That sounds stressful! I recommend calling a tow service directly… I know, but they also need someone to help them wait for the tow and check on their medications! I understand. We can provide a caregiver to assist them while they wait. That might be the best option. What’s the process for getting someone there quickly? I can arrange for a Personal Care Assistant to go to them right away. This typically costs $28 to $35 per hour. That sounds reasonable. How quickly can someone get there? I can initiate the coordination immediately. Can you provide me with their exact location? They’re just off Highway 54, near the Oak Street exit. Got it. I’ll arrange for someone to head that way right now. Thank you so much! What about their medication? We can include medication management as part of the service; it’s $65 to $80 for a visit. That sounds good. Can you ensure the caregiver knows their meds? Absolutely! I’ll make sure to include all relevant info for the caregiver. Thank you! Is there anything you need from me to finalize this? Just a contact number for the caregiver to reach your parents when they arrive. Sure! It’s +13165555832. Thank you, Mark. I’ll get that set up right now. I really appreciate your help. No problem at all! We’ll keep you updated. Perfect! I’ll wait for your call. Have a good day, Mark! You too, thanks again!
